description: This file contains class definitions and methods for various evaluation metrics in Spark's MLlib, including evaluators for classification, regression, clustering, and ranking, with implementations wrapping Java/Scala counterparts.

classes.name: Evaluator
classes.description: Abstract base class for evaluators that compute metrics from predictions.

classes.name: JavaEvaluator
classes.description: Base class for evaluators wrapping Java/Scala implementations.

classes.name: BinaryClassificationEvaluator
classes.description: Evaluator for binary classification metrics, expects rawPrediction, label, optional weight.

classes.name: RegressionEvaluator
classes.description: Evaluator for regression metrics, expects prediction, label, optional weight.

classes.name: MulticlassClassificationEvaluator
classes.description: Evaluator for multiclass classification metrics, expects prediction, label, optional weight, probability.

classes.name: MultilabelClassificationEvaluator
classes.description: Evaluator for multilabel classification, expects prediction and label columns.

classes.name: ClusteringEvaluator
classes.description: Evaluator for clustering results, expects prediction and features columns, computes silhouette score.

classes.name: RankingEvaluator
classes.description: Evaluator for ranking metrics, expects prediction and label columns.

methods.name: _evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method to evaluate dataset and return metric.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluate dataset with optional parameters, returns metric.

methods.name: isLargerBetter
methods.description: Indicates if higher metric values are better.

methods.name: setNumBins
methods.description: Set number of bins for evaluation.

methods.name: getNumBins
methods.description: Get number of bins for evaluation.

methods.name: setK
methods.description: Set k value for ranking metrics.

methods.name: getK
methods.description: Get k value for ranking metrics.
